name: prd-architecture-studio
title: PRD & Architecture Studio
summary: Atlas, the Lead Product Engineer, and the studio's skills: a product's specification and design captured against OTO packs through the curate gates, the build with the brief in hand, and the navigable PRD and architecture site.

changelog.note: Atlas installs the packs first; oto init then declares the plugins the project uses in .claude/settings.json and records the tools in oto.lock.json; pdf-to-template is added with oto lock --use. Needs OTO 0.11.12.

The studio as a pack: Atlas and the studio's skills, the pattern-neutral architecture vocabulary (software-architecture release 10) and the prd-site view; each part's design pattern goes to its own pack (ddd:model-domain, medallion:design-pipeline). Replaces the plugin listed from Cynergis/prd-architecture-studio. Needs OTO 0.11.8.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
